decisions.statement: Every address under `/api/` no other route answers is answered here.
The answer names the method and the address that was asked for.
A route declaring no action raises the router's own error before any module runs.
Only a route declaring an action can answer that error.
The router ranks a route rather than taking that route in the order the table names.
This route beats the page catch-all route and loses to every declared api route.
No wrong address is forwarded to a route of similar name.
The tests resolve a path against the real route table rather than naming a module.

definition: that no route answers the address a caller asked for
